method: Official Google pages read through web tool; source URLs below.

sources.claims: Local results depend mainly on relevance, distance and prominence; complete accurate business details and genuine reviews may help. No guaranteed rank.
Use accurate real-world name/address, few relevant categories and one profile per business. No unnecessary service/location keywords in business name.
Services editor availability depends on category; offerings may include factual descriptions/prices. Actual profile fields require inspection.
Request genuine reviews using official link/QR and reply helpfully; no incentives.
No fake engagement, incentives, review gating, positive-only requests, pressure or requests for specific review content.
Accurate business fields and validation; markup alone does not guarantee display.
Self-serving LocalBusiness/Organization reviews are ineligible for review snippets, including embedded third-party review widgets.
